items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then there was another, he got another guy to put up money, Ross Hastings, whose family was the originator of Formica, he put a, Lenny got him to put up a lot of money in my band.

ctx.x: Like how much money in your band?

I don’t know, in those days, maybe twenty grand or something like that; fifteen thousand, or something. That was a lot of money. Then there was another, he got another guy to put up money, Ross Hastings, whose family was the originator of Formica, he put a, Lenny got him to put up a lot of money in my band. There again, how he could talk these people into coming up with money was amazing, but he was a good talker.
How did he become your manager? Did he find you or did you find him?
